title: Volume 1 Chapter 5: An Embarrassing Help
content: Recently, I’ve been spending more time with Lady Rana.
After saving her from cursed poison, our interactions changed, and I found myself helping her overcome her fear of men.
Honestly, I never imagined I would be alone with a noblewoman like this just a short while ago.
“Lord Salt, thank you for today as well.”
“Yes! Thank you for having me.”
As part of her therapy to overcome her fear of men, we decided that I would talk with Lady Rana at least once a day.
Unless we were on an expedition, I would make sure to have time to talk with her.
“What shall we talk about today?”
Lady Rana smiled gently and spoke to me.
There was no longer any fear or anxiety in her voice like before.
I could tell she was gradually beginning to open her heart to me.
“Well then, is there anything you would like to do, Lady Rana?”
I replied in a calm voice. Lady Rana lowered her eyes, contemplating for a moment, before slowly opening her mouth.
“Well, there’s something I’ve always found curious.”
“Something you’ve found curious?”
“Yes. Actually, Lord Salt, when you’re by my side… I feel strangely at ease.”
“At ease?”
“Yes.
Just like with Freina and Krush, who I’ve known for a long time, being with you makes me feel calm.
But at the same time, my chest feels warm.”
Hearing Lady Rana’s words, I couldn’t help but glance at her ample chest, which was resting in her hands.
Until now, I had tried not to look at her chest, but since she had expressed a desire for me to see her body, I made an effort to direct my gaze there as well.
Moreover, when Lady Rana mentioned her chest feeling warm, I felt a slight warmth in my own chest.
It made me happy to know that I had earned her trust.
However, at the same time, I began to sense that her feelings toward me might be gradually changing.
“Thank you. Hearing you say that, Lady Rana, makes me happy as well.”
The gaze she directed at me was different from before.
She wasn’t scared or anxious.
Yet, there was a complex emotion lurking beneath the surface, as if she was searching for something.
I didn’t quite understand it either, but I hoped we could figure it out together.
“...Lord Salt, you’ve helped me with so many things, so… um…”
Seeing Lady Rana hesitate, I felt a bit flustered.
I could tell she wanted to convey something. However, I had no idea how she would continue.
“If there’s anything I can do, I’ll help with anything. Please don’t hesitate to ask.”
If she had something she wanted to tell me, it was my duty to support her.
With that thought in mind, I carefully chose my words in response.
Lady Rana briefly averted her gaze, her face slightly flushed, before she seemed to gather her resolve and spoke.
“Lord Salt… I have a request. I’d like you to examine my health from now on.”
“Eh?”
“I will still have Aria examine me as usual, but I would like you to check on me as well.”
For a moment, I was at a loss for words.
However, her serious expression made it clear that this was not a joke or a lighthearted request.
“You want me to… examine your body?”
“Yes, it’s embarrassing to show my skin to you, a man, but I want to rely on you.”
I was momentarily speechless, unsure of how to respond to her words.
She certainly had a fear of men. Until now, she had never allowed other men to get close.
And now, she was asking me to examine her body.
“...Are you really okay with me?”
“It has to be you… I can show my skin to you…”
As she spoke, Lady Rana’s voice trembled, perhaps from embarrassment.
Yet, her gaze remained fixed on me, conveying her determination.
“Understood. Please don’t push yourself too hard. I will do everything I can.”
I accepted Lady Rana’s request, albeit with a bit of nervousness.
If I could help alleviate her fear even a little, I wanted to support her with all my might.
“Then, from now on, when we conduct the examination, could you please call me ‘Doctor’?”
“Yes! Lord Doctor.”
When Lady Rana called me “Lord Doctor,” my heart skipped a beat.
From now on, I would be examining Lady Rana.
Was that really okay? I was filled with anxiety, but this was her own request for me to “examine” her.
Honestly, I felt a bit bewildered, but I steeled myself.
Her fear of men had not been completely overcome yet. That’s why I didn’t want to push her too hard.
“Well then… let’s begin.”
I faced Lady Rana, moving a bit awkwardly.
In my heart, I kept telling myself, “It’s okay, this is an examination.”
Lady Rana seemed nervous as well, her face slightly flushed.
“First, I’d like to check your overall condition.”
At my words, Lady Rana hesitated for a moment but then nodded, slowly placing her hands on the collar of her garment.
I could see her fingertips trembling.
“...Lord Doctor, please don’t look… it’s embarrassing…”
“Of course. Please don’t worry. I’ll only look where necessary.”
I turned my back, waiting for her to prepare.
Each sound of fabric rustling made it hard for me to concentrate, but I focused on not being rude to her.
A few seconds later, I heard her small voice.
“...Is this okay?”
Her beautiful back was now exposed before me.
If I were to move to the front, I would see her ample chest. However, if I did that, I would likely lose her trust.
Even just seeing her back was indescribably beautiful.
I found myself staring in awe, but I reminded myself that this was strictly a “medical examination.”
I approached her, telling myself that.
“Now, I will check your condition.”
I reached out and gently touched her shoulder.
Lady Rana’s skin was warmer and softer than I had expected. In that moment, I noticed her flinch slightly.
“I’m going to start. Holy magic, reveal any abnormalities in her body. 《Holy Search》”
“Hmmmm…”
As my magic took effect, Lady Rana let out a soft moan.
“Does it hurt?”
“Ah, yes, mmm… it’s okay…”
Though her voice trembled slightly, it didn’t sound like she was frozen in fear.
Perhaps she was gradually getting used to my touch.
“Now, I’ll check other parts little by little. Please don’t push yourself.”
I lightly traced my fingers along her back, shoulders, and neck, making sure to be careful not to touch her inappropriately, all while keeping it within the context of a “medical examination.”
“...Lord Doctor… um… thank you. I’m not scared even when you touch me.”
I was momentarily taken aback by her words.
I never expected her to say something like that.
Her cheeks, visible over her shoulder, were slightly flushed, and her voice was filled with gratitude.
“I’m glad to hear that. If I can be of any help, I’m happy too.”
I continued the examination, responding in the gentlest voice I could muster.
I could see her gradually relaxing.
And then, becoming a bit bolder.
No, this was still a “medical examination.” I reached my hand toward her waist.
“C-can I check this area as well?”
Lady Rana took a small breath but quickly replied in a soft voice, “That’s fine.”
I gently touched her waist, checking for any abnormalities in her condition.
Of course, I wasn’t touching her inappropriately.
This was all part of the “examination.”
“Hmm… there doesn’t seem to be any abnormalities. However…”
“However?”
“It seems your waist is tired from sitting too much at work.”
When I conveyed what I genuinely felt during the examination, Lady Rana chuckled softly.
Just as I was about to pull my hand away, having confirmed that she had completely relaxed, Lady Rana suddenly grasped my hand tightly.
“...Lord Doctor, can I stay like this a little longer?”
Her words momentarily caught me off guard.
Her hand wasn’t trembling; rather, it gently enveloped mine.
I felt that Lady Rana needed me.
In that moment, I lightly squeezed her hand in return.
“Of course. I’ll stay like this until you feel safe.”
While she adjusted her clothing that had slipped off her shoulders, I kept one hand intertwined with hers.
We spent a quiet moment together like that.
Lady Rana has been becoming increasingly proactive lately.
Since I started examining her, she occasionally surprises me by striking up a conversation.
“Lord Doctor, how is my health today?”
The previous Lady Rana would never have casually spoken to a man like this.
Yet now, it felt completely natural for her to talk to me, as if she were a different person.
And there was no longer any anxiety or fear in her smile.
“Yes, you seem to be doing very well. Your condition appears stable.”
When I responded, Lady Rana smiled happily.
Every time I saw that smile, I realized just how much she had recovered.
“I’m glad to hear that. This is all thanks to you, Lord Doctor.”
I had been worried about the aftereffects of the cursed poison, but it seemed she would be able to complete her treatment without any lingering issues.
Most importantly, regarding her fear of men, Lady Rana was gradually approaching me, engaging in conversation.
She no longer kept her distance like before; in fact, she was so proactive that it left me feeling a bit bewildered.
I wasn’t the only one noticing Lady Rana’s change.
Freina and Aria, who were watching from a corner of the examination room, were also surprised by her transformation.
“...Lady Rana, you’ve become quite cheerful.”
Recently, we’ve been conducting examinations in the office without worrying about the two of them.
This must mean that Lady Rana has become accustomed to me.
Freina was in the office, and she was laughing at how I was the one being overwhelmed by Lady Rana.
“Yes, truly. I never imagined that Lady Rana would become so natural in her conversations with men.”
Aria murmured with a slightly surprised expression.
She regularly came for Lady Rana’s examinations, but it seemed she was quite astonished to see how I conducted them.
While Aria was surprised, she also wore a somewhat relieved expression.
“This is all thanks to Lord Doctor. He has gradually helped me dispel my fears.”
Lady Rana smiled at me.
Seeing that, Freina and Aria exchanged glances and shared a small laugh.
“What a remarkable change.”
“Yeah, I’m really glad to see you doing well, Lady Rana.”
Freina and Aria expressed their joy at Lady Rana’s recovery while lightly bowing their heads toward me.
“Thank you, Freina. I will continue to rely on you, Lord Doctor.”
Lady Rana looked directly at me, her eyes filled with gratitude and trust.
Her demeanor had become increasingly proactive, and a gentle warmth spread through my chest.
Aria was quietly smiling as well, and it was clear she was also pleased with Lady Rana’s transformation.
Surrounded by their smiles, the examination room was enveloped in a calm atmosphere.
